title: refactor: remove duplicate Replicate error logs
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps one complete error log per failed Replicate-backed Seedance request
- Removes duplicate message/status logging and direct adapter imports
- Leaves timeout, cancellation, and error mapping behavior unchanged

Checks:
- `npm exec -- biome check` on the three changed adapters
- `npm run test --workspace pollinations-gen -- test/image/replicateClient.test.ts`
- `npm run typecheck --workspace pollinations-gen`

gist.headline: One Buzz Per Error
gist.blurb: The Seedance video workers have agreed to stop repeating themselves. Failed Replicate requests now leave one complete, useful trail instead of a small chorus of identical warnings.
gist.summary: Removed duplicate message and status logs from the Seedance 2.5, Seedance Replicate, and Seedance V2 video adapters so each failed Replicate-backed request produces one complete error log, with timeout, cancellation, and error mapping unchanged.
gist.impact: Maintainers get cleaner Replicate failure diagnostics for Seedance video requests without any change to generation behavior or error handling.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy video-generation garden shed where Polli, wearing a tiny librarian visor, files one neat error-log scroll into a glowing lime-green terminal while duplicate paper slips dissolve into compost beneath code-plants. The scene represents clearer internal diagnostics rather than a user-facing feature.
